title: add RAG agent playground and tool-calling quickstart docs
author: Noah Patel
description: Add a developer-focused quickstart and interactive playground for RAG agents and tool-calling. Context: customers frequently ask for end-to-end examples that combine retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-calling, and the new structured response helpers. This PR adds a guided quickstart, a runnable sandbox example, and docs-site integration so users can try agents in the browser or locally. Checklist: - [x] Quickstart tutorial (markdown) with step-by-step commands and expected outputs - [x] Playable sandbox page (React) with a minimal backend proxy and sample vector store data - [x] Tool-calling examples (search, calculator, DB lookup) and sample tool adapters - [x] SDK snippets (TS/Python) demonstrating agent lifecycle and run APIs - [x] Docs-site navigation entry and search indexing - [x] Automated doc tests for quickstart commands Motivation: shorten time-to-first-success for developers evaluating agent+RAG flows and reduce support friction by providing canonical examples and tests. Backwards compat: docs only, no breaking changes. Usage notes include instructions to use local demo vector data or wire to an existing embeddings provider and how to replace the sample tool adapters with user code. Rollout plan: merged to main, staged to the docs preview site, and flagged in release notes for the next docs deploy.
